# featureflip_sdk_key (Resource)

An SDK key for an environment. The plaintext key is only available at creation and is stored in Terraform state — protect your state. Destroying this resource REVOKES the key (revocation is irreversible). Import with `<project>/<environment>/<key-id>`; imported keys cannot recover the plaintext.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "featureflip_sdk_key" "backend" {
  project     = featureflip_project.web.key
  environment = "production"
  name        = "backend"
  type        = "ServerSide"
}

# The plaintext is only available at creation and lives in Terraform state.
output "sdk_key" {
  value     = featureflip_sdk_key.backend.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `project` (String)
- `type` (String) ClientSide or ServerSide. Immutable.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext SDK key (creation-time only; empty for imported keys).
- `last_four` (String)
